name: PHARAOH
canonical: Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, a regal clean-shaven man with smooth bronze skin and kohl-lined eyes, wearing the striped blue-and-gold nemes headcloth with a rearing golden uraeus cobra at the brow, a broad jewelled usekh collar of lapis and carnelian across his bare chest, a pleated white linen shendyt kilt and gold armlets, enthroned in regal Egyptian splendour holding a crook and flail
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
